title: Formalization of the Galerkin Construction for the Two-Dimensional Navier--Stokes Equations in Lean
summary: We formalize in Lean 4 the Galerkin construction of global Leray--Hopf weak solutions for the unforced two-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations on arbitrary bounded open domains with no-slip boundary conditions. For every initial datum in the solenoidal \(L^2\) velocity space, the solution has a weakly continuous velocity path, satisfies the weak equation locally in time, and obeys the energy inequality at every time.
